 Ayushmann Khurrana recalls being rejected from Indian Idol 2 in 2006: “Your talent alone is never enough because you cannot achieve everything on your own”
 en Bollywood News Bollywood Hungama News Network https://www.bollywoodhungama.com/ Ayushmann Khurrana recalls being rejected from Indian Idol 2 in 2006: “Your talent alone is never enough because you cannot achieve everything on your own” The actor revisited his audition and reflected on how success depends on more than just talent, acknowledging the role of blessings, guidance and support from others.
 By Bollywood Hungama News Network - November 14, 2026 - 5:21 PM IST 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 Ayushmann Khurrana may have established himself as one of the bankable actors of his generation, but his journey into the entertainment industry could have taken a different turn. Before making his mark as an actor, Khurrana had also explored singing and auditioned for the second season of Indian Idol in 2006. However, he did not make it past the initial rounds.
 Ayushmann Khurrana recalls being rejected from Indian Idol 2 in 2006: “Your talent alone is never enough because you cannot achieve everything on your own” The actor recently revisited the experience while shooting for an upcoming episode of Indian Idol Legends Return. He was accompanied by filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya, who is associated with his upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya , and his co-star Sharvari. During the episode, singer Amit Sana played Khurrana’s audition footage, prompting the actor to recall his rejection from the singing reality show.
 Reflecting on the experience and his journey since then, Khurrana said, “I was rejected from Indian Idol. Success is multifactorial; there are so many people who contribute to it.”
 His journey from being turned down by a singing reality show to becoming an established actor has also shaped his understanding of success. The actor believes that talent alone cannot determine how far someone goes, as several people and circumstances contribute to an individual's achievements.
 Sharing his perspective on the subject, he said, “Your talent alone is never enough because you cannot achieve everything on your own. Initially, when you achieve something independently, you feel that you’ve made it entirely on your own. But as you experience life, you begin to understand that there are several external forces at play. It could be your parents’ blessings, your guru’s guidance, or the love and support of people who help you move forward.”
 The episode featuring Khurrana will air on November 15, where the actor will revisit this early chapter of his journey and reflect on the role that support and circumstances play in shaping success.
